svg.title: Immutable Infrastructure
svg.desc: Immutable Infrastructure. Never patch servers in place: bake a new image and replace them. Step 1, Servers drift apart: Months of fixes by hand left three identical servers different, and a bug now hits only web-3. Step 2, Bake once, launch all: The pipeline bakes image v42 from code, tests it once, stores it, and every server launches from it. Step 3, Change means replace: A security patch is out. Nobody logs in: the pipeline bakes v43 and v43 servers replace v42 ones. Step 4, Keep state outside: Replacing web-3 loses nothing: its data, settings and logs all live outside the server.

g.text: Months of fixes by hand left three identical servers different, and a bug now hits only web-3.
The pipeline bakes image v42 from code, tests it once, stores it, and every server launches from it.
A security patch is out. Nobody logs in: the pipeline bakes v43 and v43 servers replace v42 ones.
Replacing web-3 loses nothing: its data, settings and logs all live outside the server.
every change is made by hand on a running server
